foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.intro: This page checks the base of the app: design tokens, light and dark themes, languages and the layout. Real screens replace it in the next stages.
foundation.preferencesHint: Your choices are remembered on this device.
foundation.sampleBody: Chlorophyll absorbs red and blue light.
foundation.sampleMeta: {modules, plural, one {# module} other {# modules}} · due {date}
foundation.emptyText: Then share its join code and assign a course built from a paper or slide deck.

signIn.tagline: Turn papers and slides into courses your class can work through.
signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.footTeacher: New here? Signing in creates your teacher account.
signIn.footStudent: We only ask for your name. No ads, ever.
signIn.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't set up yet. Add the Supabase keys to .env.local (docs/setup-supabase.md).

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.sentTo: We sent a sign-in link to
checkEmail.instructions: Tap the link on this device to sign in. It works for 15 minutes.
checkEmail.spamHint: Check your spam folder. School email can take a minute or two.
checkEmail.canResend: You can send it again now.

onboarding.title: Finish setting up
onboarding.intro: Tell us what to call you. Your teachers and classmates see this name.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: Thanks, {name}. Your school admin needs to confirm you teach there. We'll email {email} as soon as you're approved.
pending.rejectedBody: Your school admin couldn't confirm this account. If you teach there, ask them for an invite code.
pending.haveCode: I have an invite code from my school

invite.title: Enter your invite code
invite.intro: Your school admin can give you one. It confirms you teach there, so you don't have to wait for approval.
invite.label: Invite code
invite.noCode: No code? You can keep waiting.

wrongAccount.bodyStudent: {email} signed up as a student, so it can't open teacher tools.
wrongAccount.bodyTeacher: {email} signed up as a teacher, so it can't open student pages.
wrongAccount.bodyAdmin: {email} manages teachers and invite codes, so it can't open classes.
wrongAccount.bodyNotAdmin: {email} isn't an admin account, so it can't open admin tools.
wrongAccount.differentEmail: Sign out and use a different email
wrongAccount.teacherHint: Teacher accounts use a separate email. Ask your school to invite you, or sign in with your staff email.
wrongAccount.studentHint: Student accounts use a separate email. Sign in with your student email to join a class.

home.teacherText: Your classes and courses arrive in the next update.
home.studentText: Joining classes arrives in a later update.

errors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@school.edu.
errors.rateLimited: Wait a minute before asking for another link.
errors.sendFailed: Couldn't send the link. Try again in a moment.
errors.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
errors.codeNotFound: That code doesn't match. Check it with your admin, or ask for a new one if it has expired.

invites.title: Invite codes
invites.created: Code created. Share it with the teacher.
invites.emptyText: Create one above and share it with a teacher.
invites.generic: Couldn't create the code. Try again.
